summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend review of the physiotherapy clinic platform. Backend: 32/32 pytest cases pass covering public API, booking validation, full booking lifecycle with capacity release, duplicate guard, admin auth/permissions, doctors/services/schedule/settings, testimonials consent, callbacks, CSV exports, WhatsApp webhook (unconfigured), rate-limit (429), and MFA setup/enable/disable. Frontend: home page renders (8 condition cards visible), booking wizard end-to-end succeeded (PT-2026-000024, auto-confirmed, doctor auto-assigned), admin login works, all 6 overview stat tiles + whatsapp-config-banner present, all admin pages (/appointments, /patients, /doctors, /services, /schedule, /messages, /testimonials, /analytics, /settings, /security, /audit) load without runtime errors, mobile action bar shows at 390px on home and is hidden on /book, tablet layout exposes admin-menu-toggle. Existing tests in test_engine.py and test_api_flows.py were not re-run (already known passing).

issues: Radix DialogContent missing DialogTitle triggers a11y console warning: `DialogContent requires a DialogTitle`. Should wrap title with VisuallyHidden if hidden.

action_items: (Minor a11y) Add a DialogTitle (VisuallyHidden if not shown) to Radix Dialog components in admin dashboard to remove console warnings.
(Optional UX) /admin/settings PUT requires the full settings document; PATCH-style partial update would be safer for future changes.
critical_code_review_comments: SettingsUpdate model requires all top-level sections on every PUT (no partial merge). Front-end already sends full doc, so no bug, but PATCH endpoint or model_dump(exclude_unset) would be safer.
seed_data_creation: Test bookings created via public API were cleanup-cancelled via module-scope fixture. One booking (PT-2026-000024) was created through the Playwright UI flow and is still ASSIGNED on the schedule — main agent may cancel it if needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_review_flows.py — 32 tests covering full clinic platform surface. Use rand_phone() helper (Indian 10-digit) and next_open_day() (skips Sundays). Rate limit is 8/min per IP — vary X-Forwarded-For header. Settings PUT needs full doc: GET → mutate → PUT. Testimonials schema uses fields patient_name/content/date (not `quote`). /auth/me wraps user in `{user: {...}}`. Server date reads as 2026-09-08 (Tuesday). Frontend booking UI happy-path works end-to-end and confirmation title correctly reflects acceptance mode (AUTO → 'Your appointment is confirmed').
rca_of_the_issue: None — all reviewed flows working. Only minor a11y console warning on admin dialogs (missing DialogTitle).
